title: Two-out-of-three existence and triangle preservation for partially defined derived functors
standard_prerequisites: Calculus of fractions, filtered denominator categories, Yoneda characterization of essentially constant ind/pro-objects, cofinal invariance, and functoriality/inversion for derived values already defined.
Triangulated TR3/rotation, exactness of filtered colimits of abelian groups, and the five lemma.
core_obligations: Choose essential-constancy representatives at two triangle entries and repair their comparison square by a further denominator before completing a third map.
Prove essential constancy of the third entry over the supplied filtered category of triangle denominators via exact Hom-colimits and the five lemma, then use cofinality to obtain RF(Z).
difficulty_reason: The genuinely substantial denominator-triangle cofinality construction is already a separately prepared target. After that support and the standard essential-constancy/filtered-colimit primitives, the remaining square repair and five-lemma closure are formal; treating the repeated support as fresh difficulty would overcount it.

Cofinality is proof support; these targets concern adjoint exactness or existence domains of derived functors.
